---
title: "Complete synthetic aquifer example"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

The package repository includes `dev/integration-tests/complete-synthetic.R`,
an executable fixed-seed analysis using only released synthetic fixtures. It
checks observations and events, groups screens, interpolates and validates,
inspects variograms and anisotropy, uses an explicit covariate trend, maps
support, ensembles and disagreement, creates uncertainty and pointwise contour
bands, compares events and vertical gradients, evaluates network influence,
thinning, candidates and parameter sensitivity, builds depth/profile/section
products, and validates GIS/report files.

Not every analysis needs every product. Use validation when comparing methods,
uncertainty when model-conditional variability matters, network tools for
monitoring-design questions, and profile or export tools only for the intended
communication product. None replaces hydrogeologic judgment.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
source("dev/integration-tests/complete-synthetic.R")
```
